rt:model.rt:sub:
Sub ref() Dim stat as integer
stat = ND.NodeStatus
If (stat == 14) then indikator.fill = "Col_Green"
ElseIf (stat == 13) then indikator.fill = "Col_LtBlue"
ElseIf (stat=5) then indikator.fill = "Col_Yellow"
ElseIf (stat=6) then indikator.fill = "Col_Yellow"
ElseIf (stat=7) then indikator.fill = "Col_Yellow"
ElseIf (stat=9) then indikator.fill = "Col_Yellow"
ElseIf (stat=10) then indikator.fill = "Col_Yellow"
ElseIf (stat=11) then indikator.fill = "Col_Yellow"
ElseIf (stat=12) then indikator.fill = "Col_Yellow"
ElseIf (stat == 0) then indikator.fill = "Col_Red"
ElseIf (stat == 1) then indikator.fill = "Col_Red"
ElseIf (stat == 2) then indikator.fill = "Col_Red"
ElseIf (stat == 3) then indikator.fill = "Col_Red"
ElseIf (stat == 4) then indikator.fill = "Col_Red"
End If
End Sub
